name: TAFE SA Fee Free TAFE courses
summary: Tuition-free TAFE SA places for students new to the course, jointly funded by the Australian and South Australian governments.
key: Fee Free TAFE covers the tuition fee of the course.
who: Students need to be new to the course, not new to TAFE SA
catches: Some courses may include additional fees such as a Resource Fee.
Tourism courses are not included as part of Fee Free TAFE.
The page lists 2026 offerings; 2027 places are not yet stated.
